name: Wanderlust Journey: New York City, USA

itinerary.trip_title: Wanderlust Journey: New York City, USA

days.cluster_rationale: All 4 attractions are situated within Midtown & Broadway. Walking radius is under 1.8 km, eliminating cross-city transit fatigue.
days.daily_transit_tip: Pedestrian-friendly day! Use metro/tram to arrive in Midtown; thereafter all stops are walking distance.

slots.title: Explore Midtown & Street Food & Gastronomy
slots.description: Start the day at the iconic heart of Midtown & Broadway. Wander through peaceful morning streets, avoiding tourist rushes while soaking in times square, theatre district & top of the rock.
slots.transit_to_next: 5 to 8-minute scenic walk to lunch quarter

slots.title: Artisanal Lunch in Broadway
slots.description: Relish authentic local flavors and seasonal specialties at a beloved neighborhood bistro renowned for farm-fresh ingredients and vibrant atmosphere.
slots.transit_to_next: Short 10-minute stroll across the plaza

slots.title: Immersion: Times Square
slots.description: Curated afternoon visit clustered in the same district to prevent transit fatigue. Delve into curated collections, picturesque courtyards, and local artisan shops.
slots.transit_to_next: 5-minute stroll to evening dining avenue

slots.title: Sunset Dinner & Nightlife at Midtown
slots.description: Dine with panoramic views or lively terrace seating. Conclude with evening dessert, ambient music, or a relaxing stroll beneath illuminated city architecture.
slots.transit_to_next: Direct return to hotel via local metro or taxi
